contea di ritrovamento: Hertfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Constantine I (AD 306-337) dating to the period c. AD 321-31 (Reece Period 16). BEATA [TRAN-QVI]LLITA[S] reverse type depicting a Globe on altar inscribed [VOTIS XX], three stars above. Mint of Trier. As RIC VII, p. 191, no. 305 or 318
